messages:
mara: Hey team — ACME support ticket says their EU dashboard suddenly shows "All regions" even when they select EU + model + version. Happening in prod since ~12:30 UTC. Can we triage?

mara: Quick repro I did: 1) Open org dashboard 2) select region=eu-west 3) select model=redwood-small 4) select version=2026-02-10 -> charts refresh but show totals for 'All regions' (numbers match global).

mara: Filing root cause note here before we escalate — they say it started right after the query-rewrite rollout this morning.

sre-bot: Alert forwarded: [metric-filter-normalizer] rewrites enabled at 2026-03-15T12:00:03Z for org=acme-corp, rollout=canary-50%.

devraj: thanks, mara. can you paste the network request/response from the browser devtools (preserve headers)?

mara: pasted below (sanitized):
```
GET https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/metrics?region=eu-west&model=redwood-small&version=2026-02-10
Response 200 OK
{
  "filtersApplied": {"region": "all", "model": "redwood-small", "version": null},
  "queryId": "q_01F...",
  "note": "normalized by metric-normalizer v2"
}
```

mara: interestingly version became null. frontend shows version selected but backend got null.

devraj: that lines up with what I saw in the normalizer logs. snippet from logs (service: metric-normalizer v2):
```
[2026-03-15T12:31:02Z] req=q_01F... user=acme-corp rewrite: region 'eu-west' -> 'EU' (canonical)
[2026-03-15T12:31:02Z] req=q_01F... validate: allowed_regions=[us-east,us-west,asia] - region 'EU' not found -> fallback='all'
[2026-03-15T12:31:02Z] req=q_01F... version token '2026-02-10' normalized -> '' (empty) due to semver parser mismatch
```

devraj: tl;dr: rewrite canonicalized the region to 'EU' (uppercase) then failed the allowed_regions check and fell back to 'all'. version normalization returned empty string because our semver parser rejects that format in the new path.

lin: ack. I rolled the query-rewrite change to canary earlier today to normalize vendor variants (eu-west, EU-WEST, europe -> EU). Looks like the allowed_regions list we use in the validator is still the old lowercase list and the comparison is case-sensitive. Also the semver change tightened rules.

anya: impact? ACME says billing UI is misattributing usage (EU traffic counted in global bucket). Tiered billing window opened at 12:00 UTC. This is high priority.

devraj: suggested mitigation: short-term we can bypass the normalizer by setting header `X-Preserve-Filters: true` from the console for all orgs while we fix the validator; that header path is already in the normalizer and skips rewrite. I can push a config flip to block rewrite for all production orgs immediately.

lin: I'll cut a rollback patch to revert the stricter semver logic and fix case-insensitive region check. quick plan:
- hotfix 1: make allowed_regions comparison case-insensitive (lib-level)
- hotfix 2: treat semver parse failures as no-op (preserve raw string)
- smoke test: run ACME org dashboard + sample requests

mara: customer asked for ETA. can we give 60-90 minutes if we flip config?

devraj: flipping config now for prod to bypass rewrites for all orgs. Will monitor.

sre-bot: config change: metric-normalizer.rewrite.enabled -> false applied to production at 2026-03-15T12:39:05Z by devraj.

lin: starting hotfix branch + PR, will push to prod once tests pass. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/p/metric-normalizer/+/1234 :eyes:

mara: customer notified that we're reverting rewrite and asked to confirm when they see EU charts return to normal.

devraj: prod patch deployed (hotfix v2.0.1) at 2026-03-15T13:05:17Z — reverted case-sensitive validator and relaxed semver strictness.

devraj: smoke: re-requested the original API call ->
```
GET https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/metrics?region=eu-west&model=redwood-small&version=2026-02-10
Response 200 OK
{
  "filtersApplied": {"region": "eu-west", "model": "redwood-small", "version": "2026-02-10"},
  "queryId": "q_01F...",
}
```

mara: ACME confirms charts are showing EU numbers again. They want a postmortem and a rollback window for the rewrite feature.

lin: we'll add a regression test for region canonicalization + version parsing and add e2e for org-billing edge-case. Also will add a canary check that validates allowed_regions list post-rewrite.

anya: thanks everyone. filing follow-up: INCIDENT-2026-03-15-ACME_FILTERS for postmortem. Please add runbook steps: how to flip `metric-normalizer.rewrite.enabled`, header bypass, and how to validate allowed_regions.

mara: noted. I'll update the support ticket and let ACME know the incident ID and ETA for the postmortem. :thumbsup:

lin: created PR for regression tests and will schedule a controlled re-roll of rewrite once tests + audit pass. :shipit:

sre-bot: status: resolved (customer verified). incident tag INCIDENT-2026-03-15-ACME_FILTERS closed at 2026-03-15T13:12:30Z.
